title: Mount Shasta portal opening and the 10-foot being

tellings.quote: in 2014 they opened one 2015 I interviewed almost everybody that was in the portal. What did you see? He was this 10- foot tall guy and he had boots on.

plain: A portal, a kind of doorway to somewhere else, is said to have opened at Mount Shasta in California in 2014, and people who were there describe a being about ten feet tall wearing boots. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this, saying that in 2015 he interviewed "almost everybody that was in the portal", and that when he asked what they saw, the answer was "this 10-foot tall guy and he had boots on." Cameron does not name further sources, but if true it would mean a large non-human figure was met face to face on a California mountain.
